name: dev-toolbox
description: One install for the daily software toolbox: it pulls in the development cycle (quality-kernel), the review on push (pre-push-review), spend control (usage-guard), the PR and AWS guards and the engineering skills (agent-skills), and adds fifteen stack skills of its own: TypeScript on Node, React and Next.js, Python, Docker, AWS serverless, LLM agents and tools, test planning, group brainstorming and git worktrees.
